reason: Stream D (F12) changes how a running provider tool turn fits its requests: ChatService._compact_mid_turn (conversation compaction mid-turn with the ledger replay unchanged, recorded in the turn snapshot, conversation.search offered, goal charged), the routing context_full branch and final-answer fitting ladder (help, compaction, deeper checkpoint folds via ChatTurnLedger.compacted_history(recent_groups)), context-length recovery after tools (compaction retry, second recovery after a refused clearing retry, later syntheses rebuilt), clearing order (lookups last) and identifiers kept in lookup receipts (tool_activity.lookup_identifiers), and _model_context's requested_output_tokens/target_headroom parameters. Selected: the new test_midturn_compaction.py; in-turn replay/clearing/checkpoint files (test_in_turn_context_pruning, test_turn_prompt_cache, test_tool_history_memory, test_chat_tool_loop, test_routing_prose_answer, test_synthesis_tool_declarations, test_tool_failures, test_chat_routing_tolerance); final-answer and recovery paths (test_chat_final_synthesis_recovery, test_restart_recovery_lifecycle, test_turn_outcome_history, test_chat_leftovers, test_history_content_fidelity, test_operator_help); every _model_context caller and context assembly (test_chat, test_chat_api, test_chat_context_assembly, test_conversation_search, test_context_retrieval, test_chat_reference_material, test_api_stream_context, test_context); goal charging (test_chat_goals). Counts from pytest --collect-only.
exclusions: No frontend, native or Playwright tests: no ui/ or Rust changes and no visible UI change (compaction and folding reuse existing records and the generic tool card). Harness chats, missions and provider adapters are excluded: harness turns own their context, mission compaction does not use _model_context or the chat ledger, and no adapter changed. tests/v3/test_minimal_agent_instructions.py stays excluded (its turn-protocol test already fails on origin/main). Real-Core evidence (scratch Core, OpenRouter deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash, 12K window, host mode) and the retention-eval rerun of s1/s2 are in the PR body. No full suite.
